code.name: Added
code.description: A claim stating that a substance (e.g. sugar) has been added to a food.

code.name: Contains
Innehåller
code.description: A claim that a food contains the ingredient/nutrition/etc specified in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode. Note the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.
Ett påstående om att en produkt innehåller en specifik ingrediens/näringsämne/ämne/etc.

code.name: Decaffeinated
code.description: Indicates most or all of the caffeine is removed from the product.

code.name: Enriched with
code.description: A claim that a food is enriched with the substance in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode. Enriched means adding back (to original levels) nutrients that were lost during food processing. e.g., Adding back certain B-vitamins lost in processing wheat to make white flour. Note the amount that determines enrichment is based on target market regulations.

code.name: Excellent Source of
code.description: The claim made is the trade item is an "Excellent Source of" the element specified. This is determined by any regulatory bodies what "Excellent" means or is just a marketing claim.

code.name: Excess
code.description: A claim stating the specified element is in excess of some set value either by the manufacturer or according to local regulations.

code.name: Extra lean
code.description: The item is considered to be extra lean. USFDA criteria of this term can be found in 21 CFR at www.fda.gov.

code.name: Fed with
code.description: A claim that the animal product is fed with the substance in the ClaimElementCode.

code.name: Fed without
code.description: A claim that the animal product is fed without the substance in the ClaimElementCode.

code.name: Fortified
code.description: "A claim that a food is fortified with the substance in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode. Fortified means adding vitamins or minerals to a food that weren't originally present in the food. This is often do for ""Nutrition Policy"", to ensure a population has a sufficient intake of an essential nutrient. Some foods ""may"" be voluntarily fortified; for others, fortification is mandatory. e.g., Adding vitamin D to milk. Note the amount that determines fortified is based on target market regulations."

code.name: Free from
Fri från
code.description: A claim that a product is completely free from the substance in the ClaimElementCode. Note the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.
Ett påstående om att en produkt är fritt från en specifik ingrediens/näringsämne/ämne/etc.

code.name: Fresh
code.description: The item is considered to be fresh.USFDA criteria of this term can be found in 21 CFR at www.fda.gov.

code.name: Frozen
code.description: "A product is frozen, for a longer shelf-life or preserved by freezing temperature and does not include any surface freezing that may occur during holding and transportation."

code.name: Good Source of
code.description: The claim made is the trade item is a "Good Source of" the element specified. This is determined by any regulatory bodies what "Good" means or is just a marketing claim.

code.name: Grown without
code.description: A claim stating that a substance (e.g. herbicide) has not been used in the process of growing fruits, vegetables, plants or flowers.

code.name: Guaranteed free from
code.description: A claim that a food is regularly analysed to guarantee that the product is free from the substance in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode.

code.name: Guaranteed source of
code.description: A claim that a food is regularly analysed to guarantee that the product contains the substance in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode.

code.name: Healthy
code.description: The item is claimed to be healthy. USFDA criteria of this term can be found in 21 CFR at www.fda.gov.

code.name: High
code.description: A claim that a food is high in the substance specified in the ClaimElementCode. Any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer, may only be made where the product contains the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.

code.name: High potency
code.description: Item is considered to be High Potency. USFDA criteria of this term can be found in 21 CFR at www.fda.gov.

code.name: Human grade
code.description: A product that is suitable for consumption by a human.

code.name: Increased
code.description: A claim that a food is increased specific ingredient/nutrition/etc. and any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer, may only be made where the product contains the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations. In the case of foods naturally increased amount specific ingredient/nutrition/etc.in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode, the term "naturally" may be used as a prefix to this claim.

code.name: Lean
code.description: The item is considered to be lean. USFDA criteria of this term can be found in 21 CFR at www.fda.gov.

code.name: Light lite
code.description: A claim stating that a product is "light" or "lite", and any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer, shall follow the same conditions as those set for the term "reduced"; the claim shall also be accompanied by an indication of the characteristic(s) which make the food "light" or "lite".

code.name: Limited ingredients
code.description: A product formulated with a minimal number of ingredients.

code.name: Low
Låg
code.description: A claim that a food is low in specific ingredient/nutrition/etc in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode. Any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer, may only be made where the product contains the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.
Ett påstående om att produkten har lågt innehåll av en specifik ingrediens/näringsämne/ämne/etc.

code.name: Made in facility free from
code.description: Trade item is made in a facility that is free from a specified element. This usually is regulated in a market by an authority. Please refer to the regulation specific to your market.

code.name: Made with from
Tillverkad med/från
code.description: A claim that the item is made with or from a specific ingredient/nutrition/etc. and any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer. Please refer to any local regulations that determine containment levels for the claim.
Ett påstående om att artikeln är tillverkad med/från en specifik tillverkningsegenskap.

code.name: Made with from 100%
100% tillverkad med/från
code.description: A claim that the item is made with/from 100% of a specific ingredient/nutrition/etc. and any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer. Please refer to any local regulations that determine containment levels for the claim.
Ett påstående om att artikeln är 100% tillverkad med/från en specifik tillverkningsegenskap.

code.name: Made with fresh
code.description: Food that is made with fresh ingredient that has never been frozen and it is raw, uncooked, unprocessed and not preserved.

code.name: Made with fresh and frozen
code.description: Food that is made of both fresh and previously frozen ingredient.

code.name: Made with frozen
code.description: Food that is made with previously frozen ingredients.

code.name: Made with minced
code.description: Food that is made with mechanically recovered flesh which may include blood, pigments, skin, and membrane particles, bones, and other material. It may be formed into large frozen blocks which are cut to make value-added products. It is usually used for formed fish products e.g., (breaded) fingers, nuggets or balls, fish cakes or surimi.

code.name: Made with natural
code.description: A claim describing the product is made with some natural element.

code.name: Made with organic
code.description: A claim the trade item is made with specified element which is organic.

code.name: Made with pasteurized
code.description: A food product that is made with specified ingredient which is pasteurized.

code.name: Made with unpasteurized or raw
code.description: A food product that is made with specified ingredient which is not pasteurized or it is raw.

code.name: May contain
code.description: The claim to state the product may contain some element.

code.name: May have
code.description: The claim to state the product may have some descriptive element.

code.name: Natural
code.description: A claim that a product does not contain synthetic or artificial ingredients.

code.name: Naturally free from
code.description: A claim that a product is naturally free from the substance specified in the ClaimElementCode. Note the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.

code.name: Naturally high
code.description: A claim that a product is naturally high in the substance specified in the ClaimElementCode. Any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer, may only be made where the product contains the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.

code.name: Naturally low
code.description: A claim that a product is naturally low in the substance specified in the ClaimElementCode. Any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer, may only be made where the product contains the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.

code.name: Naturally vegan
code.description: Products that are aligned to the definition of vegan, but in addition are made from a single natural product without additional ingredients or additives. Local regulations, where they exist, prevail since a vegan or vegetarian declaration for naturally vegan or vegetarian products could be objected to by the authorities as advertising with self-evident facts, especially for mono-products.

code.name: Natural source of
code.description: A claim that a food is a natural source of the substance in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode. Note the amount that determines if the product is a significant source of a given substance is based on target market regulations.

code.name: No
code.description: A claim that a product does not contain (verifiably) the substance in the ClaimElementCode. Note the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.

code.name: No added
code.description: A claim that the manufacturer has not added the substance in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode.

code.name: Non-alcoholic
code.description: A claim that a food contains no alcohol. Note the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.

code.name: Packed in
code.description: A claim the trade item is packed in a specified element. Example Juice.

code.name: Partially made with from
Delvis tillverkad med/från
code.description: A claim that the item is partially made with/from specific ingredient/nutrition/etc. and any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer. Please refer to any local regulations that determine containment levels for the claim.
Ett påstående om att artikeln är delvis tillverkad med/från en specifik tillverkningsegenskap.

code.name: Previously frozen
code.description: Meat, poultry, or fish that has been frozen and thawed prior to sale.

code.name: Pure
code.description: A claim that a food is Pure for a specific ingredient/etc. in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode or the trade item itself. Note the determination a product/ingredient is "Pure" is based on target market regulations.

code.name: Raised Without
code.description: A claim the trade item is raised without any of a specified element.

code.name: Real
code.description: A claim that a food contains "Real" not imitation, specific ingredient/trade item/etc.in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode or the trade item itself. Note the determination that a ingredient/trade item is "Real" is based on target market regulations.

code.name: Reduced less
Reducerat
code.description: A claim that a food has a reduced amount of the substance in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode. Note the amount that determines a reduced amount is based on target market regulations.
Ett påstående att en produkt har en reducerad mängd från en specifik ingrediens/näringsämne/ämne/etc.

code.name: Source of
code.description: A claim that a food is a source of the substance in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode . Note the amount that determines containment is based on target market regulations

code.name: Sweetened with
code.description: A claim that a food is sweetened with a specific ingredient/nutrition/etc. and any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer, may only be made where the product contains the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.

code.name: Unsalted
code.description: Without salt (sodium chloride). Salt has not been added.

code.name: Unscented
code.description: Unscented refers to a product having no added fragrance or scent.

code.name: Unsweetened
code.description: Without sugar or a similar substance having been added

code.name: Vegan
Vegan
code.description: Products that are aligned to the definition of vegan, but in addition are made from a single natural product without additional ingredients or additives. Local regulations, where they exist, prevail since a vegan or vegetarian declaration for naturally vegan or vegetarian products could be objected to by the authorities as advertising with self-evident facts, especially for mono-products.
Ett påstående att en produkt är vegansk

code.name: Without
code.description: A claim that a product is without intentional addition of the substance in the ClaimElementCode. Note the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.

code.name: Very low
Mycket låg
code.description: A claim that a food is very low in specific ingredient/nutrition/etc in the nutritionalClaimNutrientElementCode Any claim likely to have the same meaning for the consumer, may only be made where the product contains the amount that determines containment or lack of containment is based on target market regulations.
Ett påstående att en produkt har ett mycket lågt innehåll av en specifik ingrediens/näringsämne/ämne/etc.
